shellCommands.command: find app lib -type f | head -50 && echo "--- config" && cat next.config.ts
grep -o "unstable_navigation\|unstable_prefetch" node_modules/next/cache.d.ts node_modules/next/cache.js 2>/dev/null | sort -u; echo "---"; ls node_modules/next/cache*
(PORT=3123 npx next start > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3123/

cd /tmp
for v in 2 3; do
  echo "=== next-router-prefetch: $v ==="
  curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' -H "next-router-prefetch: $v" http://localhost:3123/projects/acme > /tmp/pf$v.txt
  echo -n "title 'Acme Storefront': "; grep -c "Acme Storefront" /tmp/pf$v.txt
  echo -n "description 'Commerce storefront': "; grep -c "Commerce storefront" /tmp/pf$v.txt
  echo -n "fallback 'Loading details': "; grep -c "Loading details" /tmp/pf$v.txt
  echo -n "fallback 'Loading project': "; grep -c "Loading project" /tmp/pf$v.txt
done
echo "=== full navigation ==="
curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' http://localhost:3123/projects/acme > /tmp/nav.txt
echo -n "title: "; grep -c "Acme Storefront" /tmp/nav.txt
echo -n "description: "; grep -c "Commerce storefront" /tmp/nav.txt

cd /tmp
probe() {
  local label="$1"; shift
  curl -s "$@" "http://localhost:3123/projects/acme?_rsc=x" > /tmp/out.txt
  echo "=== $label ($(wc -c < /tmp/out.txt) bytes) ==="
  for pat in "Acme Storefront" "Commerce storefront" "Loading details" "Loading project" "Production deployment"; do
    printf "  %-24s %s\n" "$pat:" "$(grep -c "$pat" /tmp/out.txt)"
  done
}
probe "shell prefetch (3)" -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'next-router-prefetch: 3'
probe "per-link prefetch (2)" -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'next-router-prefetch: 2'
probe "navigation (no prefetch hdr)" -H 'RSC: 1'

probe() {
  local label="$1"; shift
  curl -sL "$@" "http://localhost:3123/projects/acme" > /tmp/out.txt
  echo "=== $label ($(wc -c < /tmp/out.txt) bytes) ==="
  for pat in "Acme Storefront" "Commerce storefront" "Loading details" "Loading project" "Production deployment"; do
    printf "  %-24s %s\n" "$pat:" "$(grep -c "$pat" /tmp/out.txt)"
  done
}
probe "shell prefetch (3)" -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'next-router-prefetch: 3'
probe "per-link prefetch (2)" -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'next-router-prefetch: 2'
probe "navigation" -H 'RSC: 1'

pkill -f "next start" ; sleep 1; (PORT=3124 npx next dev > /tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 8; curl -sL -o /dev/null -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'next-router-prefetch: 2' http://localhost:3124/projects/acme; curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3124/projects/acme; sleep 3; cat /tmp/dev.log; pkill -f "next dev"

PORT=3124 npx next dev > /tmp/devlog.txt 2>&1 &
sleep 9
curl -sL -o /dev/null -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'next-router-prefetch: 2' http://localhost:3124/projects/acme
curl -sL -o /dev/null http://localhost:3124/projects/orbit
sleep 4
cat /tmp/devlog.txt
kill %1
git status --short && echo "--- AGENTS.md head ---" && head -20 AGENTS.md
